node.statement: From sigma(cU)=conj(c)*sigma(U) and sigma(J)=J, differentiating sigma(exp(it)J)=exp(-it)J at t=0 gives D-sigma_J(iJ)=-iJ, hence i*reals*J is invariant. In the chi_+ coordinate, the vertical tangent of the U(1)-orbit is the same line i*reals*J (the coordinate of exp(it)J has derivative iJ), so DF_+(0) acts as -I on that line.
